d:
Factory workers in Haryana are losing fingers and hands on power press machines used to make auto parts.
The Indian Express’s Bhuvan Malik reports from Faridabad and Manesar on unsafe production pressure, treatment after accidents and gaps in factory inspections. The report also looks at garment workers in Delhi’s Kapashera, where long hours and strict targets take a slower toll on health.
Report & Edit: Bhuvan Malik
Voiceover: Uma Vishnu
